package.description: View saved logins from a local Firefox profile

en-US.description: View saved logins from a local Firefox profile
en-US.longDescription:
Keywise reads key4.db and logins.json from a local Firefox profile and
shows the saved logins to the profile owner. It handles both the legacy
3DES and the AES-256-CBC key formats introduced in Firefox 144. Win32
native app, one static binary, no NSS nor sqlite dependency.
en-US.name: Keywise
